verdict.rationale: Perplexity's own Search API docs explicitly list "domain filtering" as a capability, and the overview cites "advanced filtering". These are first-party claims, but each is only a one-line mention. Nothing in the pack shows whether filtering supports both allowlisting (restrict) and denylisting (exclude), or whether it also applies to Sonar answers. Missing for 10: documented parameter names and semantics for include vs. exclude lists, limits on the number of domains, applicability to the Sonar chat-completions endpoint, code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
